answer: To forge sybil resistance, the network binds agent identities to a quadratic stake-burning auction. When rogue nodes wander into the protocol to spin up artificial replicas, the burn requirement scales superlinearly: registering n identities forces the attacker to irreversibly burn stake proportional to O(n^2). This explosive economic friction guarantees that any hostile flood collapses under its own exponential cost, leaving the adversary stranded like a lone traveler upon a barren dune.
